content: The pass is closed until day 5 — it's day 1. Pushing at the rocks is wasted time. Best plan: read the notice board (confirms schedule, useful info), then spend the days productively farming the meadow soil until day 5, then walk the east corridor to the chest.

args.approach: Rockslide Pass (11,4) is impassable until day 5 per wiki; it's day 1, so instead of pushing rocks we read the notice board, then till/plant/water crops in the meadow to pass the days, then walk the east corridor (x 11) north to the chest at (11,1).
